contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: A party dress on SHEIN comes down to three things: the occasion, the fabric and the arrival date. For Christmas and New Year's Eve, timing matters more than the style. For graduation and wedding guests, the doubts are about color, length and tone. Below, three dresses from the store with fabric, lining and rating.

contentSections.heading: How to choose by occasion
paragraphs: End-of-year party: timing rules. The order goes through processing before shipping, and the delivery date shows only on the order page. If the party falls during Christmas or New Year's week, place the order only after you see the delivery estimate.
Graduation: color and length decide. Check the invitation and the time. At night, long and midi tend to work. By day, a short or mid-length style fits better.
Wedding guest: the tone of the event comes before the style. Day or night, church or banquet hall. Check the invitation and the ceremony time before choosing the color.
Wedding dresses and bridesmaid dresses are outside this guide.

contentSections.heading: How to read the item description
paragraphs: Before paying, read the item description, not just the photo. It lists composition, lining, sheerness, length, closure and care.
bullets: **Fabric:** polyester with elastane is very common in these dresses. Check the percentage of each material, not just the name.
**Lining and sheerness:** without lining, the color of your underwear may show.
**Length:** midi, long and short change the look. Title and description do not always match, so check the measurement in centimeters.
**Care:** the description says whether the piece is machine-washable, hand-washable or dry-clean only. If dry-clean only, plan on a dry cleaner.

contentSections.heading: Size: use the garment's measurements
paragraphs: There is no single size chart: use the one for the dress you chose. SHEIN publishes a guide for each piece, in centimeters and inches, with how to measure.
The Firerie describes itself as slim fit, which calls for more precise bust and waist measurements.
postParagraphs: For plus sizes, the method is the same: compare the garment's measurements with yours, not the number on the label.

contentSections.heading: Timing: add up to the party date
paragraphs: The order goes through processing before shipping. Add the processing days to the delivery estimate the order page shows. If the total goes past the party date, that dress is not the right buy for that date.

contentSections.heading: Taxes: check the order summary
paragraphs: Import taxes depend on the country where the order arrives and on the order value. The order summary shows the amount before you pay.

contentSections.heading: Exchanges and returns
paragraphs: To swap for another size, count on a return and refund, and place a new order with the right measurements.

contentSections.heading: Before paying
bullets: The delivery estimate appears on the order page. Check it before paying.
postParagraphs: A platform coupon is valid once per order, with every payment method.

4CW5Y is not a coupon. It is the SHEIN referral code: you search for it in the app's search bar, you do not paste it at checkout, and it gives no discount and does not stack with anything. contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Will a SHEIN party dress arrive in time for Christmas? It depends on the order date. Add the processing days and the delivery estimate on the page, and compare with the party date.
How can I tell if the dress is long or midi? By the length the description states and by the measurement in centimeters in the piece's size guide.
Can I use 4CW5Y to get a discount? No. It is a referral code: it gives no discount and is not a coupon.

takeIf: Take it if the delivery estimate on the order page arrives before the party date.
Take it if the description lists composition, lining and length in centimeters, and the garment's measurements match yours.
skipIf: Skip it if processing plus delivery runs past the party date.
Skip it if the piece has no lining and the sheerness bothers you, or if it is dry-clean only and you do not want a dry cleaner.
